children: Metal Sky Star will liquidate and expects to redeem public shares for about $16.41 per share.
Board will not seek extension and will liquidate, redeeming public shares within 10 business days of decision.
Public shareholders expected to receive approximately $16.41 per share from the trust account, net of taxes and up to $50,000.
Company will cease operations except to effect the distribution and wind up affairs after redemption.
Sponsor waived redemption rights for founder and private placement shares; rights and warrants will not receive distributions.
Plans include delisting, SEC deregistration via Form 15, and liquidation of the trust account with Wilmington Trust as trustee.
